summary: Recorded a sourced open question instead of a claim about the one unexplained observation in the extended-window receipt (index 0): the demoted node's own GetConfiguration still reported itself as a Voter after a 3s bounded settle loop, while the leader and both far nodes reported the demotion. Source trace shows a peer's own view is the atomic copy written by setLatestConfiguration, which only runs when a configuration entry is appended (via appendEntries) or installed, so the observation would mean that peer had not appended an entry the others had already committed. Native, unretained reproductions of the same construction three ways (waiting before demotion, demoting immediately, and the exact per-node timing) converged within 0-21ms in every case, so this is either a rare replication stall on one peer or a run artefact. The new question records the hypothesis, the discriminator that would separate a replication stall from a configuration-entry processing gap from an artefact, and notes that the VerifyLeader finding does not rest on it. The VerifyLeader line remains closed with its gap answered, all comparisons complete and holding, and the defect claim asserted on the retained receipts.
